verdict.rationale: Loops is an email SaaS platform rather than an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. First-party docs describe an official MCP server at loops.so/agents/mcp: agents connect from any client and can read and write contacts, events, mailing lists, content and transactional email. A probe confirms the documented endpoint. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and detailed setup/auth docs specific to MCP connection.
